Strategy

Strategy at Narris begins with interpretation. We study how customers, partners, investors and teams understand you, then shape a position that is clear, coherent and true to your intent.

Discuss this service Request a quotation

What our strategy work includes

  1. Positioning audits

    An account of how you are positioned today, set against how you intend to be.

  2. Stakeholder alignment reports

    Where each audience's understanding matches intent, and where it does not.

  3. Perception analysis

    How customers, partners, investors and others interpret the organisation.

  4. Audience interpretation frameworks

    A way to read and anticipate how audiences will understand what you say.

  5. Strategic reports and executive briefings

    Concise, decision-oriented documents written for senior readers.
